name: Create BGP Filter Profile
description: Create BGP Filter Profile Creates a new BGP filter profile for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/filter_profiles
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/filter_profiles
Creates a new BGP filter profile for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete BGP Filter Profile
description: Delete BGP Filter Profile Deletes a BGP filter profile. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/filter_profiles/{profile_id}

name: Get BGP Filter Profile
description: Get BGP Filter Profile Gets a specific BGP filter profile for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/filter_profiles/{profile_id}

name: Get BGP Settings
description: Get BGP Settings Gets the BGP settings for an account, including the default ASN and redistribution configuration. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/settings
Gets the BGP settings for an account, including the default ASN and redistribution configuration.
Required: account_id (path)

description: Update BGP Filter Profile Updates a BGP filter profile. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/bgp/filter_profiles/{profile_id}
